then.text: Signed, sealed and on its way. Wilberforce rode out to the Wolds villages himself at election time, you know. Mind, it took him four days to get round.

else.text: A petition against the slave trade, from Hull? Give it here.
Wilberforce was MP for all of Yorkshire from 1784, and that meant the Wolds too. Our farmers voted for him.
There. My name, and the vicar's, and the woman who does the flowers, who has very firm opinions.
Two names down on the petition. One more to go, in Hull.
Welcome to All Saints. Yes, the stone outside is older than the church. Older than the Romans. We've stopped arguing with it.
Winifred Holtby, the writer, is buried in the churchyard here. She wrote 'South Riding', about East Yorkshire folk, and died young in 1935.
